coverage.sourceFile: FEC 2025-2026 contributions from committees to candidates (PAS2)

methodology: Direct committee-to-candidate transactions use FEC spender-side 24K, 24P and 24Z records after keeping the latest filing version for each FEC transaction ID. Independent expenditures, coordinated expenditures and communication costs are excluded from direct contribution totals. Memo rows marked X are not added to totals. Sector labels are a POLITICS browsing taxonomy based on committee names, not FEC industry classifications.
